summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for Athanasia: Ang Hiwaga ng Diwa, a Philippine mythology dark-fantasy multiplayer card and tactical board game. Includes full-stack WebSocket/HTTP room matchmaking with AI bot fill, 50-tile serpentine elemental board, rich Tagalog folklore decks (Sumpa, Pahiwatig, Pagsubok, Biyaya, Kapalaran), social deduction Impostor mechanics, modular admin card/asset editor with stacked effect engine, and Vercel deployment guide.
